1.title: Saudi Arabia joins US in strikes on Iran-backed militias in Iraq
1.summary: US Central Command says proxy groups launched attacks against US bases and Saudi energy infrastructure.

2.title: What to Know About Lindsey Graham’s South Carolina Memorial
2.summary: The senator’s funeral service will be held in Columbia, the capital. His remains will be buried in Pickens County, S.C., where he was born and raised.

3.title: Trying to Make a Buck Off a Data Center, One 6-Pack at a Time
3.summary: What do you do when a $25 billion complex is under construction nearby? One couple in Abilene had an idea.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. and Saudi Airstrikes Drag More Countries Into Fighting
4.summary: Global oil prices jumped on Wednesday after the U.S. and Saudi Arabia said they had carried out joint airstrikes on Iranian proxies in Iraq.

5.title: Japan ‘Races Against Time’ to Reach People Trapped After Large Quake
5.summary: Rescue personnel are working to free those trapped in collapsed buildings after a 6.8-magnitude earthquake struck Kumamoto on Tuesday.

6.title: Summer of Heat, Fires and Storms Is a Reckoning for Europe on Climate
6.summary: The continent is experiencing some of its biggest fires and highest temperatures ever. Residents are fleeing, leaders are struggling to respond and “it will get worse,” one climate expert said.
